1 (Currently Amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure, wherein said open rib structure is configured to provide structural reinforcement to said belly pan.

2 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner, wherein each corner is reinforced to enhance structural integrity.

3 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure, wherein each section is designed for optimal weight distribution.

4 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure, wherein each aero cover enhances aerodynamics of the vehicle.

5 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, wherein the configuration provides an improved airflow.

6 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, wherein the configuration improves vehicle performance.

7 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, enhancing overall structural support.

8 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel, wherein the fasteners enable easy replacement during maintenance.

9 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress, wherein each buttress supports the structural integrity of the pan.

10 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress, further enhancing reinforcement.

15 (Currently Amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, wherein both covers are aerodynamically designed.

16 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners, where the fasteners enhance join strength.

17 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section, optimizing stability.

18 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, improving rigidity.

19 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, further enhancing rigidity.

20 (Currently Amended): The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, optimizing structural load distribution.
